extended_web_catalog.name: IDOR / BOLA (Object-Level Authorization)
extended_web_catalog.summary: The server does not verify the caller is entitled to the specific object the request names.

extended_web_catalog.name: Missing Function-Level Authorization
extended_web_catalog.summary: An endpoint checks that the caller is authenticated but not that they hold the required role.

extended_web_catalog.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery
extended_web_catalog.summary: A state-changing request is honoured from a foreign origin using the victim's ambient credentials.

extended_web_catalog.name: Cross-Site Scripting
extended_web_catalog.summary: Attacker-controlled data reaches a script execution context in another user's browser unneutralised.

extended_web_catalog.name: SQL Injection
extended_web_catalog.summary: Attacker input is concatenated into a SQL statement so the query structure becomes attacker-controlled.

extended_web_catalog.name: NoSQL / Operator Injection
extended_web_catalog.summary: A document query is built from a parsed structure so type and operator semantics become attacker-controlled.

extended_web_catalog.name: Server-Side Template Injection
extended_web_catalog.summary: User input is compiled as template source rather than rendered as data.

extended_web_catalog.name: OS Command Injection
extended_web_catalog.summary: Attacker input reaches a shell or process launcher and becomes part of the executed command.

extended_web_catalog.name: XML External Entity Injection
extended_web_catalog.summary: An XML parser resolves external or entity-expanded content the attacker controls.

extended_web_catalog.name: Insecure Deserialization
extended_web_catalog.summary: Untrusted data is deserialised into a type that carries behaviour, so the payload chooses the code path.

extended_web_catalog.name: LDAP / XPath / NoSQL-Style Injection
extended_web_catalog.summary: A filter or path expression is built from attacker input, changing the query structure.

extended_web_catalog.name: Server-Side Request Forgery
extended_web_catalog.summary: The server fetches an attacker-influenced URL, crossing into networks the attacker cannot reach directly.

extended_web_catalog.name: Path Traversal / File Inclusion
extended_web_catalog.summary: A caller-supplied name resolves outside the intended directory.

extended_web_catalog.name: Unrestricted File Upload
extended_web_catalog.summary: The server accepts an upload without constraining type, name, location or interpretation.

extended_web_catalog.name: Request Smuggling / HTTP Desync
extended_web_catalog.summary: Front-end and back-end disagree about where one request ends, so one request becomes two.

extended_web_catalog.name: CORS Misconfiguration
extended_web_catalog.summary: The cross-origin policy grants a foreign origin more access than intended.

extended_web_catalog.name: Host Header Injection
extended_web_catalog.summary: The server builds a security-relevant URL or decision from a caller-controlled Host header.

extended_web_catalog.name: Open Redirect
extended_web_catalog.summary: A redirect target is not constrained to a trusted destination.

extended_web_catalog.name: CRLF / Header Injection
extended_web_catalog.summary: User input reaches a header or line boundary the protocol treats as a delimiter.

extended_web_catalog.name: Web Cache Poisoning
extended_web_catalog.summary: Unkeyed attacker input is reflected into a response the cache stores and serves to others.

extended_web_catalog.name: Web Cache Deception
extended_web_catalog.summary: A cache stores a personalised response under a key that other users can request.

extended_web_catalog.name: Clickjacking / UI Redressing
extended_web_catalog.summary: A foreign page can frame and overlay the target so the user's click means something they did not intend.

extended_web_catalog.name: Prototype Pollution
extended_web_catalog.summary: Caller input reaches a property write path that mutates a shared prototype.

extended_web_catalog.name: JWT / Token Validation Failures
extended_web_catalog.summary: The application makes an authorisation decision from a token whose signature, algorithm or claims it never verified.

extended_web_catalog.name: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC Misconfiguration
extended_web_catalog.summary: The authorization server or client accepts a redirect, scope, audience or flow it should reject.

extended_web_catalog.name: Authentication Failures
extended_web_catalog.summary: The mechanism that establishes identity can be bypassed, reused, or subverted end to end.

extended_web_catalog.name: Session Management Flaws
extended_web_catalog.summary: Session identity, lifetime or binding is weaker than the operation's risk requires.

extended_web_catalog.name: Business Logic Flaws
extended_web_catalog.summary: A sequence or amount that the business intends to constrain can be reached out of order or out of proportion.

extended_web_catalog.name: Race Conditions / TOCTOU
extended_web_catalog.summary: A check and the operation it guards are not atomic, so interleaving changes the outcome.

extended_web_catalog.name: Mass Assignment / Excessive Data Exposure
extended_web_catalog.summary: The write or read surface covers fields the caller should not control or see.

extended_web_catalog.name: GraphQL Attack Surface
extended_web_catalog.summary: A single flexible endpoint exposes schema, depth and per-field authorisation the REST surface would separate.

extended_web_catalog.name: WebSocket Weaknesses
extended_web_catalog.summary: The persistent channel inherits origin, authorisation and message-validation weaknesses of its upgrade request.

extended_web_catalog.name: API-to-API Trust Failures
extended_web_catalog.summary: A backend assumes its caller is trusted because the caller is internal, and the boundary is never enforced.

extended_web_catalog.name: Information Disclosure
extended_web_catalog.summary: Error output, directory listings or metadata reveal more about the system than the caller should learn.

extended_web_catalog.name: Security Misconfiguration
extended_web_catalog.summary: A deployable default or an absent hardening control leaves a capability the design assumed was closed.

extended_web_catalog.name: Dependency / Supply-Chain Risk
extended_web_catalog.summary: Trust placed in a component, its registry or its build exceeds what was actually verified.

extended_web_catalog.name: Subdomain Takeover
extended_web_catalog.summary: A DNS record still points at a de-provisioned service that anyone can now claim.
